read.thesis: Q4 gross margin fell 550bp to 54.9% on tariffs and markdowns while North America stays flat and China grows 28%; 2026 EPS guided $12.10–12.30 versus $13.26, with no supply-side cut in North America.

capex.quote: we expect capital expenditures to be approximately $725 million to $745 million

triggers.label: Gross margin 60.4% → 54.9%
triggers.quote: Gross profit for the fourth quarter was $2 billion or 54.9% of net revenue compared to 60.4% in Q4 2024.

triggers.label: Inventory units +6% vs guided high single digits
triggers.quote: On a unit basis, inventory increased approximately 6%, below our guidance for an increase in the high single digits.

triggers.label: North America full-price flat in Q2, positive H2
triggers.quote: we'd expect positive year-over-year growth in full price to begin in Q2 and continue into the second half

triggers.label: 2026 EPS $12.10–12.30 vs $13.26
triggers.quote: we expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $12.10 to $12.30 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025.

triggers.label: China Mainland revenue up 28%
triggers.quote: In China Mainland, revenue increased 28% with comparable sales increasing 26%.

guidance.quote: We expect revenue to be in the range of $11.35 billion to $11.5 billion, representing growth of 2% to 4% relative to 2025.
By region, we expect revenue in North America to be down 1% to 3%, with the U.S. down 1% to 3%.
We expect revenue in China Mainland to be up approximately 20%
we expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $12.10 to $12.30 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025.
For the full year, we expect gross margin to decrease approximately 120 basis points relative to last year
we expect it to decrease by approximately 250 basis points versus last year.
we expect capital expenditures to be approximately $725 million to $745 million.
we expect to open approximately 40 to 45 net new company-operated stores in 2026
we expect revenue in the range of $2.4 billion to $2.43 billion, representing 1-year growth of 1% to 3%.
We expect earnings per share in the first quarter to be in the range of $1.63 to $1.68

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 550bp; tariffs 520bp
red_flags.quote: Tariffs had a gross negative impact of 520 basis points in the quarter

red_flags.label: North America full-price not positive until H2
red_flags.quote: flipping positive in the second half of the year

red_flags.label: CEO search ongoing; proxy contest costs
red_flags.quote: we have onetime costs associated with the expected proxy contest this year

evasions.quote: I'd like a little more time just to understand what's going on with the high-value guests.
We haven't put a fine point on the leverage aspect.
